requirements.statement: A user can sign in to the app so their todo list is tied to their own account

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is presented with a sign-in flow before seeing any todos
After signing in, the user lands on their own todo list

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can add a new todo with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo in the user's list
A newly created todo starts as not completed

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can see all of their todos in one list

criteria.must: The todo list screen shows every todo belonging to the signed-in user
A user never sees another user's todos in their list

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can mark a todo as completed and unmark it

criteria.must: Marking a todo as completed updates its status to completed
Unmarking a completed todo returns its status to not completed

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can edit the title of an existing todo

criteria.must: Editing a todo's title and saving persists the new title

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can delete a todo

criteria.must: Deleting a todo removes it from the user's list

requirements.statement: A user's todos persist across sessions and devices

criteria.must: Signing out and signing back in shows the same todos as before sign-out
Todos added in one session are visible when signing in again from a different browser session
